mapper.select: SELECT A.USER_ID, A.PASSWORD, A.ROLES_STATUS, A.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NAME, E.EMAIL, E.EMP_TEL, C.CONTEXT AS AUTH_ROLE_NAME, IMG.EMP_FILENAME, -- 프로필 사진 파일명 추가 E.DEL_STATUS, A.WITHDRAW_STATUS, A.EMP_TYPE, A.APPROVAL_STATUS FROM ACCOUNT A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON C ON A.ROLES_STATUS = C.MIDDLE_STATUS AND C.BIG_STATUS = 200 -- [수정] EMP_IMAGE 테이블을 LEFT JOIN하여 사진 정보를 가져옵니다. LEFT JOIN EMP_IMAGE IMG ON A.EMP_NO = IMG.EMP_NO AND IMG.ORDER_NUM = 1 WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOUNT A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, T1.* FROM ( SELECT A.USER_ID, A.ROLES_STATUS, A.EMP_NO, A.WITHDRAW_STATUS, A.REG_DATE, E.EMP_NAME, C.CONTEXT AS AUTH_ROLE_NAME FROM ACCOUNT A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON C ON A.ROLES_STATUS = C.MIDDLE_STATUS AND C.BIG_STATUS = 200
ORDER BY A.REG_DATE DESC ) T1 ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT A.USER_ID , A.ROLES_STATUS , A.EMP_NO , A.EMP_TYPE , A.APPROVAL_STATUS , A.WITHDRAW_STATUS , E.EMP_NAME , E.EMAIL , A.REG_DATE FROM ACCOUNT A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO WHERE A.EMP_NO = #{empNo}
SELECT A.USER_ID FROM ACCOUNT A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMP_NO = E.EMP_NO WHERE A.EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} AND A.EMP_TYPE = 'EXTERNAL' AND A.APPROVAL_STATUS = 8 AND A.WITHDRAW_STATUS = 0
